title: Even absolute moments from a subgaussian MGF
source_anchor: Generic probability supplement source-only.json: moment statement and four source proof steps; pinned Mathlib definition of HasSubgaussianMGF.
target_statement: For any probability measure mu, real random variable X satisfying Mathlib HasSubgaussianMGF(X,c,mu), c a nonnegative real, and natural m, abs(X)^(2m) is integrable and its integral is at most (2m)! exp(1/2) c^m. Natural zero powers use the usual 0^0=1 convention; c=0 and m=0 are included.
